from pathlib import Path
import json

TARGET="DEV-PRED-A2Z-DIRECT-SOL-REGRESSION-N1E36-20261007"
p=Path.home()/".local/state/prediction-project-executor"/(TARGET+".json")
if not p.is_file():
    raise RuntimeError("STATE_MISSING")
o=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
print("STATUS="+str(o.get("status")))
print("TASK_ID="+str(o.get("task_id")))
print("SOURCE_COMMIT="+str(o.get("source_commit")))
print("COMPLETED_AT="+str(o.get("completed_at_utc")))
ops=o.get("operations") or o.get("operation_results") or o.get("results") or []
print("OPS_TYPE="+type(ops).__name__)
print("OPS_COUNT="+str(len(ops) if hasattr(ops,"__len__") else -1))
print("OPS_JSON="+json.dumps(ops,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True)[:14000])
blob=json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True)
print("TARGET_TEST_PRESENT="+str("tests/model_execution/test_direct_sol_chat.py" in blob))
print("UNITTEST_PRESENT="+str("unittest" in blob))
# Extract every explicit integer rc-like field for deterministic classification.
rcs=[]
def walk(v,path=""):
    if isinstance(v,dict):
        for k,x in v.items():
            np=(path+"."+k) if path else k
            if k in {"rc","returncode","exit_code"} and isinstance(x,int):
                rcs.append((np,x))
            walk(x,np)
    elif isinstance(v,list):
        for i,x in enumerate(v):
            walk(x,f"{path}[{i}]")
walk(o)
print("RCS="+json.dumps(rcs,separators=(",",":")))
